headline: A 2004 order changes legal protections for Iraq's Development Fund and certain Iraqi property, and adds protection for Iraq's Central Bank.
what_it_does: This executive order changes earlier rules that shielded the Development Fund for Iraq and certain property in which Iraq has an interest. It also extends protection to the Central Bank of Iraq. The title does not explain exactly how the protections were changed, so the details are unclear from the source material.

who_it_affects.group: Government of Iraq and the Central Bank of Iraq
who_it_affects.how: Certain Iraqi funds and property, including those of Iraq's central bank, are covered by modified US legal protections.

who_it_affects.group: People or companies with legal claims against Iraq
who_it_affects.how: The order may change whether they can pursue Iraqi funds or property in the United States, though the title gives no specifics.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 29, 2004; the source material gives no separate effective date.
